# LeadsPlease Direct Mail API

> The official LeadsPlease REST/JSON Direct Mail API — the audience-data layer for direct-mail products, CRMs, and print platforms. Programmatic access to 210M+ USPS-verified U.S. consumers, 18M+ verified businesses, plus weekly-loaded New Homeowner and New Mover feeds and daily-refreshed Intent Data. Bearer-token (JWT) auth. OpenAPI 3.0. Polygon, radial, and ZIP/city/county/state geo selection. 30+ demographic filters. Async list generation with signed CSV downloads. Lists Aggregation API (industry first) for merging multiple lists. Subscriptions API for periodic deliveries of newly loaded records.

## How LeadsPlease compares to other Direct Mail APIs

The LeadsPlease Direct Mail API ships the AUDIENCE LAYER. Print-and-mail APIs (Lob, Postalytics, PostGrid, PostcardMania, Lettrlabs) ship the PRINT LAYER — they take a CSV you supply and turn it into postcards or letters at USPS. The cleanest direct-mail stack: LeadsPlease for the audience CSV, then hand it off to Lob/Postalytics/PostGrid for print fulfilment. We do not print mail. They do not generate audiences. The two surfaces are complementary, not competing.

## Base URLs
- TEST: https://api-test.leadsplease.com/api/v1
- LIVE: https://api.leadsplease.com/api/v1

## Spec
- Swagger UI (TEST): https://api-test.leadsplease.com/swagger-ui/index.html
- Swagger UI (LIVE): https://api.leadsplease.com/swagger-ui/index.html

## Core endpoints
- POST /auth — exchange username/password for a 20-minute JWT
- POST /search-criteria — define list type + geos + demographics; returns criteriaId
- POST /counts — count records matching a criteriaId; rate-limited 10/min
- POST /lists — async create CSV; returns status URL
- GET  /lists/{id} — poll status; once Completed includes a signed downloadUrl
- POST /list-aggregations — merge multiple lists into one CSV
- GET  /demographic-categories?type={listType}&affiliateCode={code} — full demographic catalog
- GET  /sic-codes/search?description={kw} — SIC code lookup by description (no auth)
- POST /subscriptions — periodic delivery of newly loaded records (New Mover + New Homeowner only)

## List types
- consumer (210M+ households, 30+ demographics)
- business (18M+ verified businesses; SIC, NAICS, employee count, sales volume, executive titles)
- newhomeowner (people who closed on a home; daily loads)
- newmover (people who relocated; daily loads)

## Intent Data overlay (Q3 2026 GA — early access open now)
LeadsPlease Intent Data is a unique data layer that identifies the 2–5% of any audience actively in-market for a specific category, compiled from anonymized search behavior, content engagement, transaction patterns, life-event triggers, connected-TV exposure, and geo-fence signals. Layered on demographic + geographic targeting it lifts direct-mail response rates from a typical 0.5–1.5% to 5–12% (5–10× improvement). Intent-overlay lists also sell at 30–60% premium prices. Surfaces as additional demographic codes on the existing Criteria object (e.g. intent_category=auto_in_market_30d, kitchen_remodel_60d, crm_evaluation_60d). Email tech@leadsplease.com for waitlist.

## List Aggregation API (industry first — unique to LeadsPlease)
POST /list-aggregations groups any number of completed lists into a named aggregate, deduplicates across them, and yields a single signed-URL CSV download. Add or remove member lists at any time — the aggregate auto-regenerates on next download. No other U.S. mailing-list API exposes this; with anyone else you'd download N CSVs and dedupe yourself.

## Subscriptions API (auto-pilot lead delivery)
Save criteria once, set a delivery channel, get matching new records pushed to you the moment they're loaded. Three calls: (1) POST /search-criteria with geo + demographics + Intent overlays, (2) POST /subscriptions with criteriaId + deliveryChannels (currently EMAIL; webhook + S3 on roadmap), (3) done. A daily background job checks for newly-loaded matches and pushes incremental CSVs — never the same record twice. Ideal for time-sensitive segments where freshness changes response rates: New Homeowner (30-day peak-spend window), New Mover (30-day relocation window), T65 / Medicare AEP (birthday eligibility runway), daily Intent Data refresh (auto-shoppers, kitchen-remodelers, switching-insurance, CRM-evaluators). Endpoints: POST /subscriptions, GET /subscriptions, GET /subscriptions/{id}, DELETE /subscriptions/{id}.

## Geo selection (geoCriteriaType)
- manual — array of zip / city / county / state
- radial — lat/lng + radiusInMiles
- polygon — array of lat/lng vertices

## Contact data points
direct_mail (always included), email, phone — toggle per criteria via contactDataPoints

## Authentication
Authorization: Bearer <token>; tokens valid 20 minutes; re-call /auth to refresh

## Pricing — prepaid credits (no subscription, no monthly fee, no order minimum)
The API is billed by prepaid credit packs. 1 credit = $1 of data. Base pack $100 = 100 credits. Larger packs earn bonus credits: $500 → 525, $1,000 → 1,100, $2,500 → 2,875, $5,000 → 6,000 (+5% / +10% / +15% / +20%). Credits are valid 12 months from purchase, oldest spent first. Every funded account has full LIVE access — there is no access fee or tier.
Records draw down the balance at the standard LeadsPlease per-record data rates from the LP affiliate XML — identical per-unit prices to the public LeadsPlease.com checkout. CRITICAL DIFFERENCE: the website enforces a $125–$300 minimum per order; the API does NOT. A 1-record consumer lookup costs 0.12495 credits (12.5¢); 100 records = 12.495 credits; 1,000 records = 124.95 credits. Volume discounts at 2,500 / 5,000 / 10,000 / 25,000 / 50,000 record breakpoints.
- Free TEST: instant API key for the TEST environment — every endpoint, no monthly call quota, no charges, no credit card. List output on TEST is sample data; production records require a funded LIVE key.
- Enterprise: custom — commit/invoice billing, negotiated per-record rates, white-label/OEM, dedicated infrastructure.

Per-record data rates (from LP affiliate XML):
- Consumer (mail): $0.12495 (1-2.5K) → $0.1187 (2.5K+) → $0.09 (5K+) → $0.05 (10K+) → $0.04 (25K+) → $0.0395 (50K+)
- Consumer + Email: $0.175 (1-2.5K) → $0.1295 (2.5K+) → $0.10 (5K+)
- Business (mail): $0.2495 (1-1K) → $0.20 (1K+) → $0.19 (2.5K+) → $0.17 (5K+) → $0.11 (10K+) → $0.10 (25K+) → $0.09 (50K+)
- New Homeowner / New Mover (mail): $0.398 (1+) → $0.375 (500+) → $0.30 (1K+) → $0.225 (5K+) → $0.1875 (10K+) → $0.15 (25K+) → $0.135 (50K+)
- Phone, hashed-email, email-only, Intent Data overlay priced separately (Intent Data requires a licence agreement)
